items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_sub_le
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (i : σ) (p q : MvPolynomial σ R) : MvPolynomial.degreeOf i (p - q) ≤ max (MvPolynomial.degreeOf i p) (MvPolynomial.degreeOf i q)

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_sub_lt
items.type: {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {x : σ} {f g : MvPolynomial σ R} {k : ℕ} (h : 0 < k) (hf : ∀ m ∈ f.support, k ≤ m x → f.coeff m = g.coeff m) (hg : ∀ m ∈ g.support, k ≤ m x → f.coeff m = g.coeff m) : MvPolynomial.degreeOf x (f - g) < k
